turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi. I wanted to talk to you about your essay. It isn't on the LMS, and the deadline was Friday.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Really? I sent it to you by email on Thursday evening. Sorry, what's the LMS?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: The Learning Management System. It's the course website. I said, 'Send it through the LMS.'

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Oh, I understand now. I only heard 'send it', so I thought email was fine. I didn't know it had to go on the website.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That's okay. A few students made the same mistake.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can I upload it today? I can do it right after this.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes. If it's there before five, it counts as on time.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great, thank you. Where do I put it on the website?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Okay. Week 6, then 'Essay', before five. Thank you.
